summary: Titan Mining Corp filed a Form 6-K on May 29, 2026, disclosing a material change: effective May 22, 2026, Ms. Ashley Kates, CPA, CA, was appointed as Interim CFO following the resignation of Mr. Kevin Hart for personal reasons. Ms. Kates brings 15+ years of mining finance experience and was not previously an insider. The filing is a routine material change report (Canadian Form 51-102F3) commemorating an abrupt CFO departure, not a routine AGM circular. No shareholder vote or board recommendation is required. Watch for any subsequent 6-K or 8-K confirming a permanent CFO search or any further executive turnover.
